snippet.title: Pokémon Solar Eclipse - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download and more info: https://eeveeexpo.com/threads/9048/
Discord: https://discord.gg/3TSCu3Nuxf

Pokémon Solar Eclipse is a non-profit fan-game created by Peti & Gelato using RPG Maker XP and Pokémon Essentials v19.1. It will be free upon release.

This game is no affiliated with Nintendo, the Pokémon Company, Creatures Inc, or GameFreak in any way. Please support the official releases.
